nodes.goal: Load Wall Street's surface, roads and buildings from the Lower Manhattan extract in the repository.
From each street, draw the buildings on the GPU in four directions looking up at 45 degrees, write each street's share of sky as a new table, and map it between the buildings.

dataflow.name: Sky seen from the street
dataflow.description: A render pass on the GPU: from each street around Wall Street in Lower Manhattan, Autark draws the buildings in four directions, looking up at 45 degrees, and counts how much of each frame is sky and how much is buildings. It writes the streets as a new table, each with its share of sky, and a map draws that table between the buildings.
